our research findings suggest that small firms should not only consider the internal factors that can be used as a basis for developing a green business strategy, but also the external factors that can affect their ability to gain competitive advantage and improve performance.

small firms’ adoption of a green business approach is not only a socially responsible action but also an effective strategy that helps them to gain a competitive advantage, which, in turn, translates to superior market and financial performance.
small manufacturing firms’ green business strategy is a key driver of their competitiveness and performance.
the implementation of a green strategy by small firms is not just a moral or ethical issue, but a strategic one, with a number of positive outcomes.

the adoption of a green business orientation can be beneficial to small firms.
small firms can reap the full benefits of green business activities only if they are able to formulate and implement a coherent green business strategy.
